name: Accordion
description: Collapsible content sections with ARIA accordion semantics and keyboard navigation
designIntent: Accordion organizes content into expandable sections, reducing visual density on pages with lots of content. Each trigger announces its expanded state and controls its panel.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Initial open item ids when uncontrolled

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called when the open set changes

props.name: collapsible
props.description: When true, opening an item closes the others

props.name: icon
props.description: AccordionTrigger only: replace the default chevron rendered at the far right of the header.

props.name: variant
props.description: 'default' = bordered card with dividers; 'borderless' = plain stacked sections.

props.name: gap
props.description: Token gap ('lg') or exact pixels (16) between items.

props.name: items
props.description: Declarative sections ({ id, title, content, disabled }); rendered as an AccordionItem per entry instead of children.

examples.title: FAQ accordion
examples.code:
<Accordion defaultValue={['a']}>
  <AccordionItem id="a">
    <AccordionTrigger>What is Slipstream?</AccordionTrigger>
    <AccordionContent>An AI-first component system.</AccordionContent>
  </AccordionItem>
  <AccordionItem id="b">
    <AccordionTrigger>How do I install?</AccordionTrigger>
    <AccordionContent>Run npx slipstream-ui init.</AccordionContent>
  </AccordionItem>
</Accordion>

antiPatterns.title: Don't use Accordion for primary navigation
antiPatterns.explanation: Accordion is for content disclosure. Use Tabs or a nav menu for page-level navigation.

antiPatterns.title: Don't hide required information behind a collapsed panel
antiPatterns.explanation: Users may not discover it. Put critical content in the open by default.

accessibility.implementation: Trigger has aria-expanded and aria-controls; panel has role=region and aria-labelledby
accessibility.userRequirements: Every trigger needs a unique id-linked panel

accessibility.implementation: Enter/Space toggle; hidden panels are removed from tab order

guidelines: Phrase as a question or topic

compositionRules.relationship: Wrap each section in an AccordionItem with a unique id
